name: querylogger
description: Modular browser query logger with demo integration

scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build:browser
scripts.build:browser: bun build src/browser.ts --bundle --format iife --target browser --outfile dist/query-logger.js
scripts.demo: npm run build:browser && bun run demo/server.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:types && bun run test/smoke-test.mjs
